sql.query:
SELECT TOP (?) emp_cd, emp_nm, tel_no, email, mobile_no,use_yn, auth, rnum,tot_cnt
FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY a.emp_nm asc ) AS rnum, count(*) over() tot_cnt, emp_cd, emp_nm, tel_no, email, mobile_no, a.use_yn, c.cd_nm auth FROM TB_KABM_EMP a LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_KABM_CODE c ON a.auth = c.cd AND c.div_cd = 'emp_auth' ) x WHERE rnum > (?-1) * ?

mapping.getProperty: emp_cd, emp_nm, tel_no, email, mobile_no,use_yn, auth,rnum, tot_cnt

sql.query: SELECT emp_cd, emp_nm, tel_no, email, mobile_no,use_yn, auth FROM TB_KABM_EMP a WHERE A.EMP_CD = ?

mapping.getProperty: emp_cd, emp_nm, tel_no, email, mobile_no,use_yn, auth

sql.query: SELECT a.passwd FROM TB_KABM_EMP a WHERE A.EMP_CD = ?

MERGE INTO TB_KABM_EMP a USING (SELECT ? emp_cd ) b ON (a.emp_cd = b.emp_cd ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET emp_nm = ?, tel_no = ?, mobile_no = ?, email= ?, use_yn = ?, auth = ?, upd_ddtm = getdate() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (emp_cd, emp_nm, tel_no, email, mobile_no, use_yn, auth, passwd,reg_ddtm) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, getdate());

mapping.setProperty: emp_cd, emp_nm, tel_no, mobile_no, email, use_yn, emp_auth, emp_cd, emp_nm, tel_no, email, mobile_no,use_yn, emp_auth,passwd

sql.query: UPDATE TB_KABM_EMP SET emp_nm = ?, tel_no = ?, mobile_no = ?, email= ?, use_yn = ?, auth = ?, upd_ddtm = getdate() WHERE emp_cd = ?

mapping.setProperty: emp_nm, tel_no, mobile_no, email, use_yn, emp_auth, emp_cd

sql.query: UPDATE tb_kabm_emp SET passwd = ? WHERE emp_cd = ?
